name: lay-stakeholder-fairness-tradeoff-study
description: Participant study system for fairness-tolerance decisions before and after fairness-accuracy trade-off information.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @fairness-study/server" "npm run dev -w @fairness-study/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @fairness-study/web && npm run build -w @fairness-study/server
scripts.test: npm run data:generate && npm run test:research && npm run test:server && npm run test:web
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run build
